risks.risk: Console model/storage unknown (PS4 Fat vs Slim vs Pro affects value).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the console label/serial sticker showing model (CUH code) and storage, plus a photo of the system “Settings > System Information”.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-value PS4 bundle among the comparables that match only “PS4 + 2 pads + games” without assuming Pro/Slim/Fat.

risks.risk: Only one controller is clearly shown; bundle may have 1 pad instead of 2.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo showing both controllers side-by-side (front and back) and close-up of each charging port/serial sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not meeting the 2-pad claim (worst case: 1 pad).

risks.risk: Games may not be licensed, may be fewer than 10, or may not include FC24.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of all game discs/cases laid out OR a video showing the PS4 game library with FC24 visible and the total count.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed licensed and not guaranteed FC24 (worst case: generic/unknown games).

risks.risk: Condition/working status not shown (disc drive, HDMI port, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth, overheating).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video booting to the home screen and launching one game (or showing “Settings” and “Storage” while running).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possible faults (worst case: treat as needing testing).

proof_requests: Photo of the PS4 model label (CUH code) + storage capacity (serial/sticker readable).
Clear photo showing both controllers (2 pads) side-by-side.
Proof of games: either all 10 disc/case photos laid out OR a video of the PS4 library showing FC24 and the total number of games.
Short boot/test video: power on to home screen + open one game (or show Settings/System Information).
